title: 第七章 黑虎诀第八章 大魏皇朝
slug: 双穿美利坚人狱苟到玄幻发育
content_zh:
只见来人赤裸着上身，一身虬结的肌肉泛着油亮的光泽。
正是昨日的猎户赵二牛一脸期待的望着林枫。
对于林枫的话并未恼怒，只是憨憨一笑有些不好意思的挠挠头。
“林公子，打扰你休息了。
城门刚开就进来了，就想着早点回去”
“行了，进来吧”
打开街门，林枫忍不住问道：“二牛，这次猎的是什么？”
赵二牛那张国字脸露出一抹得意，那两道浓眉都格外醒目。
“这次还是两头野猪，不过这次的野猪大一些”
“嗯，拉进来”
“好嘞”
赵二牛推着架子车，车上用牛筋捆着两头如同小牛犊般的黑鬃野猪。
他步履沉稳，没有丝毫吃力。
见状，林枫也越发觉得赵二牛不简单。
“还是和之前的价格一样，20文一斤，你这两头野猪多少斤”
“林公子，来的时候称过，两头野种一共850斤。
给17两就行”
“可以”
林枫也没讨价还价，爽快的给了17两银子。
“银子没问题，多谢林公子”

“有好东西送来就是，不过低调一些”
“是林公子”
和林枫做生意，赵二牛还是很高兴的。
爽快又不磨叽，节省太多的时间了。
等赵二牛走后，林枫便手贴野猪，黑莲顷刻间便吞噬了两头野猪。
瞬间，便反馈不少气血，林枫只觉一股融融的暖意遍布全身，缓缓浸润过四肢百骸。
只感觉全身充满了精力，仿佛有使不完的劲。
再次拿出阿贵的那张硬木弓。
林枫很轻松就拉至耳后，直接拉满。
进步十分的明显。
根据猎户阿贵的记忆，他手里的这张弓是祖传的，是一石弓。
一石弓，光是弓身自重就达到了20斤，长度将近一人高。
这把硬木弓，拉力约在120斤左右。
阿贵为了拉开这把弓，光是练习拉弓，基本功就用了三年。
练习射箭又一年，练习校准又2年，实战打猎五年。
才有之前的成就。
不过这一切都被林枫继承。
content_en:
The man was naked from the waist up, and his muscles were shiny and lustrous.
It was yesterday's hunter Zhao Erniu who looked at Lin Feng expectantly.
He was not angry at Lin Feng's words, but just smiled and scratched his head in embarrassment.
"Mr. Lin, I'm disturbing your rest.
I came in as soon as the city gate opened, and I wanted to go back early."
"Okay, come in"
Opening the street door, Lin Feng couldn't help but ask: "Er Niu, what are you hunting this time?"
Zhao Erniu's face showed a hint of pride, and his thick eyebrows were particularly eye-catching.
"This time there are still two wild boars, but this time the wild boars are bigger."
"Well, pull in"
“Okay”
Zhao Erniu was pushing a cart on which were tied two black-maned wild boars like calves with tendons.
He walked steadily without any difficulty.
Seeing this, Lin Feng felt more and more that Zhao Erniu was not simple.
"The price is still the same as before, 20 cents per catty. How much do your two wild boars weigh?"
"Mr. Lin, I weighed them when I came here. The total weight of the two wild animals is 850 kilograms.
Just give me 17 taels”
"Okay"
Lin Feng did not bargain and readily gave him 17 taels of silver.
"The money is no problem, thank you Mr. Lin"
"There are good things coming, but keep a low profile."
"It's Mr. Lin"
Zhao Erniu was very happy to do business with Lin Feng.
Refreshing and non-irritating, it saves a lot of time.
After Zhao Erniu left, Lin Feng put his hand on the wild boar, and Black Lotus swallowed the two wild boars in an instant.
In an instant, a lot of energy and blood were returned, and Lin Feng felt a melting warmth spread throughout his body, slowly infiltrating his limbs and bones.
I just feel that my whole body is full of energy, as if I have endless energy.
He took out Agui's hardwood bow again.
Lin Feng easily pulled it behind his ears and filled it up directly.
The progress is very obvious.
According to Orion Agui's memory, the bow in his hand was passed down from his ancestors and was a stone bow.
A stone bow alone weighs 20 kilograms and is nearly a person tall.
This hardwood bow has a draw weight of about 120 pounds.
In order to draw this bow, Agui spent three years just practicing the basic skills of drawing the bow.
Another year of practicing archery, another two years of practicing calibration, and five years of actual hunting.
Only with previous achievements.
But all this was inherited by Lin Feng.
